title: How a self-driving car sees
description: How does a self-driving car actually see the road? Thoma the tech imp breaks down the cameras and AI behind it.

scenes.say: This car is driving itself down a busy street. So who, or what, is actually watching the road?
There is no driver. Just cameras, and a program that learned to understand what they see.
Here's the trick. Cameras capture the scene, the AI spots cars and people, then it plans a safe path.
Up close, the car is covered in cameras, each one watching a different slice of the world.

visual.query: modern car camera sensor close up
visual.caption: Eyes in *every direction*

scenes.say: So a self-driving car sees with cameras, and thinks with AI. No magic, just a lot of watching. Thoma out!
